title: JoyInside-VLM-Agent: Product-Conditioned Multimodal Policy Learning for Embodied Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.12957v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied agents must translate multimodal observations and user requests into executable actions while adapting to product constraints, changing goals, and execution feedback. We present JoyInside-VLM-Agent, a ReAct-style multimodal agent developed through product-conditioned trajectory construction and staged policy learning for robotic platforms and smart hardware. A closed-loop sandbox generates multimodal interaction trajectories covering goal revisions and failure recovery, which are checked against execution outcomes and semantic criteria. Supervised fine-tuning and multi-teacher on-policy distillation precede reinforcement learning with DPER (Dual-Source Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation with Token-Level Evidence Routing). translated_title: JoyInside-VLM-Agent：面向具身智能体的产品条件化多模态策略学习
translated_abstract: 具身智能体必须将多模态观察和用户请求转化为可执行的动作，同时适应产品约束、不断变化的目标以及执行反馈。我们提出了JoyInside-VLM-Agent，这是一个ReAct风格的多模态智能体，通过面向机器人平台和智能硬件的产品条件化轨迹构建与分阶段策略学习开发而成。一个闭环沙盒生成涵盖目标修订和失败恢复的多模态交互轨迹，并依据执行结果和语义标准进行校验。在强化学习之前，先进行监督微调和多教师在线策略蒸馏；强化学习采用DPER（双源特权在线策略自蒸馏与token级证据路由）方法。DPER在冻结的特权教师与共享推理策略参数的特权学生之间路由token级证据，在调节由奖励推导的token优势的同时保持其符
tldr: 本文提出JoyInside-VLM-Agent，一个通过产品条件化轨迹构建、闭环沙盒数据生成与分阶段策略学习（含新颖的DPER强化学习方法）训练的ReAct式多模态具身智能体，能够将多模态观察与用户请求转化为可执行动作，并适应产品约束、目标变化与执行反馈。
en_tdlr: This paper presents JoyInside-VLM-Agent, a ReAct-style multimodal embodied agent trained through product-conditioned trajectory construction, closed-loop sandbox data generation, and staged policy learning (including a novel DPER reinforcement learning method), enabling it to translate multimodal observations and user requests into executable actions while adapting to product constraints, changing goals, and execution feedback.
